title: Credits Carried onto Monthly Draft Notices — Installment Payment Plans Statement Explanation
content:
*Account statement explanation for Owner Auto Policy terms billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan.*

Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, a plan of this kind may hold a credit — an amount by which its account balance falls short of the premium not yet billed on any invoice. The premium not yet billed on any invoice is the scheduled installment premium of every unbilled installment (the full-term premium billed less the down payment premium less the scheduled installment premium for each invoice already issued) plus the endorsement premium not yet billed (every additional premium transaction booked on the Owner Auto Policy term, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the scheduled installment premium once for each of them). The installments unbilled at a notice are the plan's number of installments less the invoices already issued, the notice's own installment included.

**The amount a draft notice carries**

- **Credit of 100.00 or more, two or more installments unbilled:** the notice carries an equal share of the credit — the credit divided by the installments unbilled at the notice, rounded half up to the cent — as a reduction, and the rest stays for the later notices.
- **Any credit, the notice's installment the only one unbilled:** the notice carries the credit up to its scheduled premium plus the plan's installment fee; any rest is refunded when the plan closes.
- **Otherwise** — a credit below 100.00 with two or more installments unbilled, an unpaid earlier amount, or nothing — the notice carries the standing balance (the account balance less the premium not yet billed on any invoice), an unpaid earlier amount added and a credit subtracted.

**Hypothetical statements**

| Credit held | Installments unbilled | Scheduled premium of the notice | Plan installment fee | Carried onto the notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 300.00 | 4 | 180.00 | 4.00 | 75.00 credit (300.00 divided by 4); 225.00 stays |
| 99.99 | 4 | 180.00 | 4.00 | 99.99 credit (the standing balance) |
| 100.00 | 3 | 180.00 | 6.00 | 33.33 credit (100.00 divided by 3, rounded) |
| 250.00 | 1 | 180.00 | 6.00 | 186.00 credit; 64.00 refunded at plan close |
| 45.00 | 1 | 180.00 | 4.00 | 45.00 credit |

The records read are the plan's account balance and invoices and the additional premium booked on the Owner Auto Policy term.
